name: Rockstor
description: Shows a Rockstor NAS (version 5 and newer) as a host with the Docker containers of its installed Rock-ons as guests: state, version and the ports each container publishes, matched to the devices on your network. Reads through Rockstor's REST API over HTTPS, read-only. Also fills the Storage page (Netlens 0.4.180).
author: Netlens
supports: Rockstor 5 (written from the source code; simulator only, not tested on a real Rockstor)

releases.changelog: Also fills the Storage page (pools, volumes, disks, shares). Needs Netlens 0.4.180 or newer.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
